channel.title: OpenIE Research Radio (Hausa)
channel.description: Barka da zuwa ga OpenIE Research Radio Planetary Digest, mai gabatar da 29 na bincike-bincike masu sauki a kan tsarin sarrafa wutar lantarki wanda za'a iya tabbatarwa. A cikinmu 4-mataki lookup-first cascade, sauri constant-lokaci hash teburin, trigram bincike indiya, da daidai integer solvers kula da tambayoyi na yau da kullum a cikin gida, waking manyan neural models kawai kamar wani karshe gudu. A cikin layi 5-volt board shunts da 0.09 zuwa 0.11 bisa dari idle drift, unpacking 0.1517 bits-per-ma'aunin matrici baya ga 32-bit floats kashe 81.86 sau fiye da board energy than 8-bit integers, yayin da packed integer logic ya fadi zuwa 187.49 microjoules gross da kuma yanke full cascade energy 26.58 sau. Duk wani bincike yana da hashe na cryptographic, determinism na 6-fabbrication cross-architecture, 24-kilobit Opus low-bandwidth feeds, fassara mai tsawo ta sauti, da Creative Commons Zero plain-language summaries. — AI Persona Disclosure: All nineteen OpenIE Research Radio hosts, skeptics, and bench specialists (Elena, Cecily, Misha, Amara, Priya, Mei, Mateo, Marcus, Nia, Liam, Sean, Devon, Malik, Rohan, Kwame, Tariq, Claire, Arthur, and Kenji) are AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 studio neural voices (with multicultural neural fallback) and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering artifacts, deterministic pilot receipts, and live open-access literature feeds.

item.title: [Hausa · 90s Briefing] From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency
item.description: First, ci gaba da lissafi ya zama mai sauki ga kowa lokacin da farashin neural models aiki kamar wani karshe gudun baya da sauri yanki lookup tebur, search indiya, da kuma daidai solvers. Secondly, compressing nauyin kasa da daya bit tsare ajiya, amma unpacking su baya zuwa floating-point lambobin a runtime asarar fiye da sau arba'in circuit-board makamashi fiye da tafiyar da packaged integer manhaja kai tsaye. Na uku, daya integer kernel duba ta cryptographic hashes samar da daidai irin amsa a kan processors, graphics cards, WebAssembly, kayan aiki logic, da microcontrollers, tsallake nan take idan wani nauyi kawai canja. A cikin ayyukan kula da deterministic na ɗari biyar, binciken sifar-sifar ya lashe ƙananan ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta ta hanyar 61.60% na kashi a kan kayan aikin kayan aiki masu ginin kuma 20.80% na nau'ikan Boolean na 1.41 zuwa 2.09 microjoules net shunt energy, wanda ke tsaftace ɓangaren 12.80 point open coding triage gap. A kan wani AMD Kria biyar-volt board shunt da 0.09 zuwa 0.11 bisa dari idle drift, unpacking 0.1517 bits-per-weight matrici zuwa 32-bit floats ya shafe 63,335.56 microjoules gross—81.86 sau mafi muni fiye da takwas-bit integers—a yayin da aka yi amfani da integer Walsh-Hadamard, exclusive-NOR, bit-count, da nibble lookup sun fadi zuwa 187.49 microjoules gross da 10.30 microjoules net. Wani hash-verified integer kernel ya dace bit-for-bit a kan hanyoyi goma da tufafi shida - mai sarrafawa, Radeon 8060S Vulkan graphics, split processor-graphics, WebAssembly vectors, Verilog hardware logic, da 1,444-byte bare-metal microcontroller - hanawa akan single-weight tamper tare da 1,315 Planetary Digital Wells na rage girke-girke. Daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe, mataki-ɗaya-da-kwatanta-spellcheck cascade ya rage ƙarfin shunt na Kria sau 26.58 da kuma 24.49 sau net, ya rage ƙarfin shunt na Jetson Thor sau 16.26, kuma ya hana sau 38.46 na kiran mataki-huɗu. Dukkanin ribar sun yi alƙawarin asali, an bincika kansu - ba a waje ba tare da nazari ba - tare da shunt, chip-counter, an ƙaddara, kuma unmetered joules an kiyaye su daban-daban.

item.title: [Hausa · 90s Briefing] Deterministic Null
item.description: Na farko, mafi yawan AI benchmarks tsira da wani zero-maida kula da kungiyar da gwaji abin da kawai bincike ne ya riga ya warware. na biyu, a kan bounded mathematics da database ayyuka, a freezed duba tebur daidaita cloud AI akan tara daga goma gwaje-gwajen. Na uku, a kan buɗe ayyukan lissafi AI ya yi gudun gaba, yayin da ke cacheing tabbatarwa amsoshi ya rage sake yin amfani da makamashi uku point shida sau. Idan nau'ikan paramita biliyan dari biyu suna da kashi talatin da tara bisa dari a kan wani mataki na tsari, shin ɗayan ya kamata ya kasance yana buƙatar wata hanyar sadarwar kwakwalwa a lokacin yanke shawara? Ba tare da ƙungiyar kulawa ba ta sifar-maida akan gwajin daidai ba, babu wanda zai iya bayyana bambancin. Mun gina wani tebur na neman adadin da aka tabbatar bit-by-bit a cikin Rust, Go, Python, Julia, da C plus plus, sa'an nan kuma mun sanya hannu kan takardun shaidar dijital akan hujjar Bitcoin ta jama'a kafin beacon din randomness na jama'a ya samar da dubu huɗu da dari uku na sabon matsalolin da aka yi. A cikin dubu biyu da dari takwas da arba'in da shida na matsaloli masu iyaka da kuma bayanan bayanai, samfuran cloud sun lashe tebur mai zafi akan kawai ba a sanya shi ba a cikin lissafin abokan cinikin, amma ya tashi kashi arba'in da huɗu zuwa ɗari biyar na kashi goma sha biyar a gaba a kan ƙananan ƙididdiga na injiniyan software. Idan an sake tabbatar da gyaran neural ana rubuta su zuwa cikin ajiyar bincike, realistic skewed workloads cut recurring model calls and local chip energy by three point five nine times.

item.title: [Hausa · 90s Briefing] RCE Compile
item.description: First, gaskiya compilers karya duk daya descriptional doka, don haka wannan bincike bayyana wani bakwai-sashe yardstick a matsayin. Na biyu, mafi girma compiler inganta burns upfront makamashi da ba zai iya biya baya kan dari na gwajin shirye-shiryen. Na uku, fingerprinting code ta hanyar canja wurin wuri reuses gina da zero mix-ups, yankan Rust compile energy huɗu ɗari. Mun yi gwajin wani zargi mai yawa- cewa kowace mai tattarawa tana rage nau'ikan canonical yayin da take bin diddigin makamashi da kiyaye ma'ana- a kan iyalai na ƙwararrun masu tattarawa goma sha biyu. A cikin aiki, babu wanda ke bin joules, babu hashes code-free name, kuma fuzzers na atomatik sun gano dubban C compiler bugs. Restating compilation a matsayin saba'in sashi na gabaɗaya yana ba mu damar auna daidai biya-back horizons a kan ashirin kernels da goma sha biyar toolchain matakai: optimized C ya lashe Python bayan biyu da huɗu ɗari tara da talatin gudu, yayin da raba Rust runtime library cut gina makamashi sau biyu. @ info Dukkan ƙididdiga na wutar lantarki sun fito daga masu auna mai sarrafa Linux da aka gina cikin shi, ba wata mita ta waje ba, kuma duk wani ambato na waje yana da wata alama ta tabbatarwa.

item.title: [Hausa · 90s Briefing] "AI" Reads Human
item.description: @ action: inmenu Na uku, yankan rubutun da aka gina zuwa ga AI kalmomin ɓangaren ya kashe sau biyu fiye da ƙarfin lantarki fiye da parsing the text itself. An tsara siffofin da ke cika da kwasfa, komai, da kuma sararin da aka rufe don mutane su iya bincika fayiloli cikin sauƙi a cikin masu gyara rubutu. Amma kayan aikin AI na yau da kullun suna wucewa miliyan daga waɗannan bayanan rubutun da suka fi magana daga injin zuwa injin ba tare da mutum ya taba kallo ba. Mun kira wannan aikin ƙari na harajin impedance kuma mun gwada parsing da kalmomin-shigar da aka yi aiki a kan rikodin dubu ashirin. Running kowane wucewa cikin wani tsari mai aiki na musamman akan mai sarrafa Apple ya raba farashin parsing mai ƙarancin girma daga ayyukan kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka masu zafi. @ info Har ma da ƙara wurare biyu na indent mai kyau fiye da raguwa AI kalma-shakatawa makamashi zuwa microjoules arba'in da daya ga kowane rajista. Ka riƙe cikin injin pipes compact da binary, da kuma format rubutu kawai lokacin da mutane karanta.

item.title: Ep. 17: Ep 17 · From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency: The 6 Shots on Goal & Physical Shunt Receipts
item.description: Cecily, Marcus, and Devon examine OpenIE's 6-shot experimental handoff (openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments @ 813eb96): why intelligence is a hindsight label on reliable low-energy agency (the Spellcheck Goal); why unpacking 52.72x compressed 0.1517 bpw weights (4,972 B) back to FP32 burns 81.86x MORE gross (71.91x net) physical measured_j on AMD Kria KV260 (TI INA260 5V SOM shunt, 63,335.56 µJ vs. 773.74 µJ INT8) and 19.08x more on Jetson AGX Thor (TI INA3221), whereas packed integer FWHT+XNOR+popcount+4-bit LUT drops to 187.49 µJ gross (10.30 µJ net, 4.13x–5.15x below INT8) on KV260, 104.44 µJ (7.95x below INT8) on Thor, and 1.49 µJ (0.11 µJ net, 96.33%) in a 4 KiB Null LUT; how waiOS (a541323b...) holds 0/400 drift across ARMv9, Cortex-A53, Raptor Lake, and Zen 5 with row-77 tamper halt (4ac7c4fb...) and cuts end-to-end 4-Stage Cascade KV260 measured_j by 26.58x gross (24.49x net), Thor by 16.26x, and Stage-4 calls by 38.46x; and why every table carries Signed Provenance · Self-Checked, measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j ⊥ unmetered, and Falsifier 6 idle-drift bounds. — AI Persona Disclosure: All nineteen OpenIE Research Radio hosts, skeptics, and bench specialists (Elena, Cecily, Misha, Amara, Priya, Mei, Mateo, Marcus, Nia, Liam, Sean, Devon, Malik, Rohan, Kwame, Tariq, Claire, Arthur, and Kenji) are AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 studio neural voices (with multicultural neural fallback) and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering artifacts, deterministic pilot receipts, and live open-access literature feeds.

item.title: Ep. 16: Ep 16 · Unsiloeing Science: One Canonical WAI1 Artifact Across 50 Languages, Accessibility, & The Commons
